_synthetic: Hand-written SYNTHETIC fixture, written from recollection of Calibre-Web's public OPDS behaviour. Hand-written, unverified against the deployed version; a recorded read-only contract check is a separate owner-approved step before any real data is read. Invented ids and titles.
_schema: An Atom (OPDS) search feed served as text by GET /opds/search, held here as a head plus per-entry XML so the fake can filter by title. Unverified.
_target_version: Calibre-Web (Automated) OPDS 1.2 Atom feeds; the deployed version is not recorded in this repository and was NOT confirmed
_provenance: GET /opds/search?query=<term>: the Atom feed wrapper and entry shape are as for /opds/new (recalled from Calibre-Web's public behaviour, not re-checked). SYNTHETIC assumptions: the search route takes the term as the query parameter `query` (the OpenSearch form) rather than a path segment; it returns the same entry shape; it searches title and author; the viewer account sees the same catalogue as any member (no per-member restriction in use).
